thread:
incident-bot: [ALERT] metering.token_count_drift detected in eu1 (prefix window). Multiple overage flags firing for a small subset of customers. Severity: P2. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/metering-drift
pagerduty: PagerDuty: on-call alex.sre has been notified and acknowledged the incident
alex: Acknowledged, joining bridge now -> https://meet.redwood/incident/1758132469. Starting quick triage.
mira: Seeing same on billing dashboards — shadow aggregator (shadow-agg-eu1) diverging from primary by ~2.4% over last 30m. Deltas skew negative (missing tokens).
jon: Any prod deploys in the last hour?
alex: No code deploys. We had an autoscale blip in eu1 at 04:10 which caused consumer lag spikes.
priya: Spinning up fallback replay pipeline: `./scripts/replay_window --region eu1 --window 2026-03-20T03:20:00Z/03:50:00Z --dry-run=false`
alex: Also toggled metrics ingestion to raw mode to bypass smoothing layer for now: POST /internal/toggle_ingest?mode=raw
support-eng: CS note: 3 customers flagged with overage emails so far, tickets opened (RD-4532, RD-4533, RD-4534). Sending holding comms now.
mira: Mitigation in progress: re-enable prefix-kvcache writeback to aggregator for eu1 and kick off a small backfill job (backfill-job-1758). ETA ~15m.
jon: From emitter logs: `2026-03-20T03:22:11Z emit_error: kafka timeout; ack_drop=9s; emitted=+0` — suggests consumer backlog + commit timeouts caused gaps.
alex: Scaling emitter-consumer eu1 -> `kubectl scale deploy/emitter-consumer-eu1 --replicas=6` and increasing consumer commit timeout in-flight. Watching metrics.
incident-bot: Status update: fallback aggregator ingesting backfill; gap reduced from 2.4% -> 0.3% after 12m.
mira: Support, please suspend automated overage emails until counts reconciled. I'll hold invoices for affected accounts.
support-eng: Done — auto-overage-emails paused and CS template sent: "We're aware of a metering discrepancy; counts reconciling; no invoices will be charged until verification."
priya: Patch queued to increase consumer commit timeout + idempotency guard (PR: https://git.redwood/merges/PR-1428). Deploying to canary now.
alex: Can we re-run billing reconciliation for the affected window once backfill completes? Mira, please own reconciliation & hold.
mira: Will run manual recon and hold invoices. Estimated runtime 45m, will post results here.
jon: Current health: primary vs shadow match within 0.02% over last 5m. No new overage flags observed.
alex: Marking incident mitigated; keeping bridge open for 1h monitoring. Follow-ups: improve emitter backpressure metrics, add synthetic token-heartbeat probe, add alert for consumer commit latency.
support-eng: Customer update posted to affected tickets. Template: "Counts are reconciling; we will not bill until verification completes. We'll follow up with a final confirmation email"
incident-bot: Incident status changed to MONITORING. Incident created: INCIDENT-20260320-1758132469. Runbook and post-incident checklist: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/metering-drift
alex: Thanks team — good coordination. I'll open a postmortem and assign owners for follow-ups.
